title: Product Specification
description: High-level product description, success criteria, and constraints. Output by the Planner role.

productName.description: Name or title of the product being built.

description.description: High-level description of the product's purpose and user value proposition.

targetAudience.description: Who the product is intended for (e.g., 'backend developers', 'SaaS operators').

successCriteria.description: List of measurable, objective success criteria. Used by evaluator for pass/fail decisions.

criterion.description: Name or description of the success criterion.

measurable.description: How to measure whether this criterion is met (e.g., 'test suite passes', 'endpoint returns 200 OK').

weight.description: Relative importance (0–1); used in rubric scoring.

dependencies.description: External systems or APIs the product depends on.

outOfScope.description: Features or work explicitly NOT included in this product definition.
